messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: prod-us-west-2 cluster GPU capacity exhaustion. inference-service-rt queue length > 800; autoscaler attempted scale but node creation failing. P50 latency climbed from 2.1s to 7.8s; error rate ~5%. Paging on-call for investigation.
sara: ack — i'm on-call, jumping in.
mits: i'm taking lead, starting triage. Can someone paste cluster-autoscaler + ASG events?
juan: pasting relevant snippets below: 
```
I0402 14:05:11 cluster-autoscaler: ScaleUp: maxNodesTotal reached for node group prod-gpu-asg (min=4, max=8) but failed to create nodes due to API errors
E0402 14:05:12 cluster-autoscaler: Failed to create instance: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform iam:AttachRolePolicy on resource arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EKSNodeRole
W0402 14:05:13 kube-controller: LaunchTemplate mismatched version (expected v4, got v3) - skipping candidate
kubelet: Node tainted gpu-scheduling=reserved:NoSchedule
```
ashley: From cloud console: ASG attempted 3 scale-up attempts, each failed during launch template attach step with 403/AccessDenied on iam:PassRole/AttachRolePolicy. Also noticed autoscaler prefers existing nodegroup but launch template version drifted (old nodes on v4, LT default set to v3).
mits: immediate mitigation plan: 1) temporarily bump ASG desired/min to force manual provisioning, 2) create small spare nodegroup with correct launch template + instance profile as fallback, 3) add temporary rate-limiting on incoming inference queue to protect SLOs, 4) notify support & customers.
zack: i'm going to manually bump ASG desired to 8 now.
```
# manual ASG bump (executed by zack)
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name prod-gpu-asg --min-size 6 --desired-capacity 8
```
incident-bot: Action logged: manual ASG bump by zack at 2245123550.
tess: support context — two enterprise customers on Dedicated capacity reporting 503s and retries. CS has been informed and initial mitigation message queued.
support-bot: Notified affected customers (customer-alpha, customer-beta); status page draft prepared: "We are investigating increased latency and errors for GPU-backed inference in us-west-2; mitigation in progress."
mits: triage notes: cluster-autoscaler cannot synthesize node because LaunchTemplate default version is older and the IAM role used by ASG lacks iam:PassRole and attach permissions needed for EC2 instance profile operations. Quick patch: grant minimal passrole to role used by autoscaler/ASG, and update LaunchTemplate default version to match nodegroup v4.
```
# example minimal fix (ops run after review)
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name AutoScaleRole --policy-name AllowPassRoleForEC2 --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["iam:PassRole","iam:AttachRolePolicy"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EKSNodeRole"}]}'
aws ec2 modify-launch-template --launch-template-id lt-0abcd1234 --default-version 4
```
ashley: I created a temporary nodegroup (temp-gpu-fallback) with the correct launch template & instance profile while IAM change propagates — verified instance boots and joins cluster.
mits: autoscaler retried scale after manual fixes, created 3 nodes successfully. Queue dropped from 820 -> 120 in ~9 minutes; error rate down to ~0.8%. Rebalancing pods across new nodes.
juan: removing restrictive taint on older nodes to allow pod eviction/drain: `kubectl taint nodes -l pool=old-gpu gpu-scheduling-`
zack: verified pods are moving and most inference workers reporting READY. Monitoring for flapping.
tess: CS update posted; customers acknowledged mitigation but want follow-up postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident mitigation timeline logged.
mits: immediate next actions (short): create IAM playbook to avoid missing iam:PassRole/AttachPolicy in ASG role, add launch-template version drift monitor to alert, add autoscaler fallback nodegroup config to onboarding docs.
ashley: opened ticket INC-2245123456-followup and assigned to infra (ashley, mits) + eng-ml (juan) for runbook updates.
sara: handing off to next on-call in 30m for follow-up checks; core customer-facing mitigation complete. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: Status page updated to "mitigated" at 2245123800; monitoring continues.
mits: final note: root cause = combination of IAM permission gap (ASG/automation role missing pass/attach permissions) + launch template version drift which caused autoscaler to reject candidates; automation should have detected template drift earlier. Postmortem to include timeline, impact (2 enterprise customers, elevated latency for ~22 minutes), and concrete remediation steps.
sara: thanks team — closing paging loop. Will catch up in postmortem. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
